1.t: Nũn. By the pen and what everyone writes

2.t: By the grace of your Lord, you ˹O Prophet˺ are not insane

3.t: You will certainly have a never-ending reward

4.t: And you are truly ˹a man˺ of outstanding character

5.t: Soon you and the pagans will see

7.t: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided
7.tr: Innaa Rabbaka Huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabeelihee Wa-Huwa a'lamu bilmuhtadeen

8.t: So do not give in to the deniers

9.t: They wish you would compromise so they would yield ˹to you˺

10.t: And do not obey the despicable, vain oath-taker

13.t: brute, and—on top of all that—an illegitimate child

14.t: Now, ˹simply˺ because he has been blessed with ˹abundant˺ wealth and children

15.t: whenever Our revelations are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables!”
15.tr: Izaa tutlaa 'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen

16.t: We will soon mark his snout

17.t: Indeed, We have tested those ˹Meccans˺ as We tested the owners of the garden—when they swore they would surely harvest ˹all˺ its fruit in the early morning
17.tr: Innaa balawnaahum kamaa balawnaaa As-haabal jannati iz 'aqsamoo la-yasri-munnahaa musbiheen

18.t: leaving no thought for Allah’s Will

19.t: Then it was struck by a torment from your Lord while they slept
19.tr: Fataafa 'alaihaa taaa'i-fum mir rabbika Wa-hum naaa'imoon

20.t: so it was reduced to ashes

21.t: Then by daybreak they called out to each other

22.t: ˹saying,˺ “Go early to your harvest, if you want to pick ˹all˺ the fruit.”
22.tr: Anigh doo 'alaa harsikum in kuntum saarimeen

23.t: So they went off, whispering to one another

24.t: “Do not let any poor person enter your garden today.”

25.t: And they proceeded early, totally fixated on their purpose

26.t: But when they saw it ˹devastated˺, they cried, “We must have lost ˹our˺ way

27.t: In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”

28.t: The most sensible of them said, “Did I not urge you to say, ‘Allah willing.’?”
28.tr: Qaala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum law-laa tusabbihoon

29.t: They replied, “Glory be to our Lord! We have truly been wrongdoers.”
29.tr: Qaaloo subhaana rabbinaaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen

30.t: Then they turned on each other, throwing blame

31.t: They said, “Woe to us! We have certainly been transgressors

32.t: We trust our Lord will give us a better garden than this, ˹for˺ we are indeed turning to our Lord with hope.”
32.tr: Asaa rabbunaaa any yubdilanaa khairam minhaaa innaaa ilaa rabbinaa raaghiboon

33.t: That is the ˹way of Our˺ punishment ˹in this world˺. But the punishment of the Hereafter is certainly far worse, if only they knew
33.tr: Kazaalikal azaab, Wa-la'azaabul aakhirati akbar; law kaanoo ya'lamoon

34.t: Indeed, the righteous will have the Gardens of Bliss with their Lord

35.t: Should We then treat those who have submitted like the wicked

36.t: What is the matter with you? How do you judge

37.t: Or do you have a scripture, in which you read

38.t: that you will have whatever you choose

39.t: Or do you have oaths binding on Us until the Day of Judgment that you will have whatever you decide
39.tr: Am lakum aymaanun 'alainaa baalighatun ilaa yawmil qiyaamati inna lakum lamaa tahkumoon

40.t: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ which of them can guarantee all that

41.t: Or do they have associate-gods ˹supporting this claim˺? Then let them bring forth their associate-gods, if what they say is true
41.tr: Am lahum shurakaaa'u fal-ya'too bishurakaaa-'ihim in kaanoo saadiqeen

42.t: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Shin ˹of Allah˺ will be bared, and the wicked will be asked to prostrate, but they will not be able to do so
42.tr: Yawma yukshafu 'am saaqinw Wa-yud'awna ilas sujoodi falaa yastatee'oon

43.t: with eyes downcast, totally covered with disgrace. For they were ˹always˺ called to prostrate ˹in the world˺ when they were fully capable ˹but they chose not to˺
43.tr: Khaashi'atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum zillatunw Wa-qad kaanoo yud'awna ilas sujoodi Wa-hum saalimoon

44.t: So leave to Me ˹O Prophet˺ those who reject this message. We will gradually draw them to destruction in ways they cannot comprehend
44.tr: Fazarnee Wa-many yukazzibu bihaazal hadeesi sanastad-rijuhum min haisu laa ya'lamoon

45.t: I ˹only˺ delay their end for a while, but My planning is flawless

46.t: Or are you asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt
46.tr: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum min maghramin musqaloon

47.t: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺

48.t: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not be like ˹Jonah,˺ the Man of the Whale, who cried out ˹to Allah˺, in total distress
48.tr: Fasbir lihukmi rabbika Wa-laa takun kasaahibil hoot; iz naadaa Wa-huwa makzoom

49.t: Had he not been shown grace by his Lord, he would have certainly been cast onto the open ˹shore˺, still blameworthy
49.tr: Law-laaa an tadaara-kahoo ni'matum mir rabbihee lanubiza bil'araaa'i Wa-huwa mazmoom

50.t: Then his Lord chose him, making him one of the righteous

51.t: The disbelievers would almost cut you down with their eyes when they hear ˹you recite˺ the Reminder, and say, “He is certainly a madman.”
51.tr: Wa-iny yakaadul lazeena kafaroo la-yuzliqoonaka biabsaarihim lammaa sami'uz Zikra Wa-yaqooloona innahoo lamajnoon

52.t: But it is simply a reminder to the whole world
